marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Sunday.
marine.text:
Wind southeast 15 knots increasing to west 20 late overnight
then diminishing to west 15 Sunday afternoon. Wind backing to south 20 Sunday
evening. Rain tonight. Fog patches forming after midnight and
dissipating Sunday morning. <br/>
